done_when: The traceable Ask story uses a key that does not collide case-insensitively with its spec slug.

findings.body:
chunk 1/3:

The roadmap entry was renamed to `ASK-TRACEABLE-IMPLEMENTATION`, but the confirmed spec's own Roadmap declaration still assigns this story the key `ASK-TRACEABLE-ANSWERS`. Lowercasing that identifier produces the spec slug `ask-traceable-answers`, so the story metadata remains inconsistent and still retains the Windows-colliding key. Rename this reference as well so the spec and roadmap identify the story with the same non-colliding key.
